evidence.title: GitHub - Johuniq/sweep: Create stunning gradients in seconds. A beautiful, modern gradient generator. · GitHub

name: Sweep
summary: Open-source gradient generator with linear and radial gradients, noise and blur effects, and CSS, Tailwind or JPG export.
description: A gradient editor for designers and developers: multi-stop color control, linear and radial gradients, adjustable angles and positions, noise and blur effects rendered on canvas, and a real-time high-resolution preview. Export the result as CSS code or Tailwind CSS utility classes, download a high-quality JPG, or copy with one click; dark mode, responsive layout and Motion animations included. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Radix UI and next-themes; MIT licensed.
contains: linear and radial gradients with multi-stop color control
adjustable angles and positions with real-time preview
noise and blur effects with canvas-based rendering
export: CSS code, Tailwind CSS utility classes, high-quality JPG
dark mode via next-themes; Motion animations; Radix UI components
Next.js 16 + React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4 app
MIT licensed; 24 GitHub stars; site listed as sweep.jolyui.dev
